The results in Figure 11 display the numerical solutions obtained by lrAA methods with and without
the ES preconditioner. In particular, both methods obtain visually similar numerical results in terms of
solution contours and column and row index section for the ﬁnal iterates. The un-preconditioned lrAA
gives a montonically increasing intermediate ranks. The ES-preconditioned lrAA converges very rapidly in
8 iterations.
